output.reason: [ev-e477115a445b] says that the unused flag `sidecar-istio-proxy-image` was removed in the 1.16 upgrade notes under "Removed Options". For a removed CLI flag, the standard exposure is cli-flag{name, set}, so the environments exposed are the ones that still pass `--sidecar-istio-proxy-image`. That is exactly what both proposals give, and it is neither broader nor narrower than the change. The evidence does not show whether the flag can also be set some other way, such as a ConfigMap key, so nothing supports widening the condition.
